title: Escalation Routing Rule R-006: Bill disputed by patient
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-006 -- Bill disputed by patient
TRIGGER TYPE: Intent
CONDITION: Attender disputes itemized charges
ROUTE TO: Billing (Extension 1028)
QUEUE: QUEUE_BILLING
PRIORITY: HIGH
SLA: 2.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Financial grievance requiring itemized tariff audit. Route to Billing Manager ext. 1028. Pause gate pass.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Patient attender refuses to pay extra consumables
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Why are we being charged for ICU support?
source_citation: SMCH Escalation Routing Matrix -- R-006 (Bill disputed by patient) v1.0
